definitions.explanation: The state or quality of something when it's completed. Refers to how something turns out after being made, processed, or prepared.

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}は{仕上|しあ}がりが{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: This dish has a beautiful finish.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}の{仕上|しあ}がりを{確認|かくにん}してください。
{期待以上|きたいいじょう}の{仕上|しあ}がりだった。

notes:
DERIVED FROM:
The verb {仕上|しあ}がる (to be finished, to turn out).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{仕上|しあ}がりを{確認|かくにん}する - to check the finish/result
・{仕上|しあ}がりが{良|よ}い/{悪|わる}い - good/bad finish
・{仕上|しあ}がり{具合|ぐあい} - state of completion
・{仕上|しあ}がり{日|び} - completion date
・{仕上|しあ}がりイメージ - finished image/visualization

USAGE CONTEXTS:
・{料理|りょうり} - cooking (appearance and taste when done)
・{写真|しゃしん}・{印刷|いんさつ} - photos/printing (final quality)
・{作品|さくひん} - artwork (final state)
・{建築|けんちく} - construction (completed appearance)
・クリーニング - dry cleaning (condition when returned)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・{仕上|しあ}がる - to be finished (intransitive verb)
・{仕上|しあ}げる - to finish (transitive verb)
・{仕上|しあ}げ - finishing touches
・{出来|でき}{上|あ}がり - completion, finished product
・{完成|かんせい} - completion

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in everyday conversation, particularly when discussing the result of work or products.
